text:
samira: hey all :wave: I'm a new SWE on infra team. Quick q about sandbox API keys 14 we've got a small load test this afternoon and I want to make sure we don't hit limits. what are default sandbox quotas (requests/min, concurrent reqs, token rate)?

devex: welcome, samira! for sandbox most teams get a modest quota. common defaults: ~60 reqs/min, a few concurrent connections, and token throughput is throttled for heavy streaming. can you share expected qps and typical response size?

samira: plan: spike to ~50 rps for ~5 minutes to simulate bursty traffic, each request ~800 tokens output. run from single CI runner in us-east-1.

infra-ops: FYI single-runner at 50 rps with 800 tokens/resp will likely hit protections. short bursts usually pass if spaced; sustained bursts trigger blocks. do you have the project id?

samira: project-qa-42. prefer short burst; is there a self-serve temp bump?

devex: yes 14 Console -> Usage -> Quota Requests. include project id, timeframe, target rps. for urgent runs ping infra-ops and we can do a manual uplift.

alex_k: I ran something similar last month. infra approved 1hr bump to 200 rps. pro tip: set REDWOOD_API_KEY in CI env and scrub logs.

samira: do keys expire? can we create short-lived key for CI?

jlee: Console keys can be ephemeral (expire after N hours) or long-lived. for CI we create ephemeral keys with minimal scopes and rotate per job. also specify a model in requests to avoid routing surprises.

ben_p: when you run curl tests, cap max_tokens and set explicit model to avoid runaway token generation. example:

```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"open-redwood-1-small","input":"...","max_tokens":800}'
```

infra-ops: submitted a ping on the quota form. if you want an expedite reply here with the time window and we can approve a short window. sandbox limits are per-project by default; note cross-project tests need mention.

samira: can we whitelist our CI runner IP for the test? helps debugging.

infra-ops: can allowlist IPs for short windows; include CIDR in the request.

onboarding-bot: reminder: new-hires checklist item "Request sandbox quota" still open for @samira 14 mark complete after approval.

samira: submitted request: https://console.redwood.ai/projects/project-qa-42/usage/quota-requests (window 1763459000-1763462600 UTC, target 150 rps). thanks all!

devex: noted, i'll add a temporary alert on the project for rate-limit errors and watch during the window. :thumbsup: 

alex_k: ping me if anything flakes. DM infra-ops if you need faster help.

samira: will do, appreciate the help :heart:
